apps.title: IPTV
apps.summary: Watch IPTV on your Android device
apps.description:
Watch IPTV from your Internet service provider or free live TV channels from any other source in the web.

Features:
 ✔ M3U and XSPF playlists support
 ✔ Playlists history
 ✔ Playing multicast streams with UDP proxy (proxy need to be installed in your LAN)
 ✔ Grid, list or tile view of TV channels
 ✔ EPG support in XMLTV and JTV formats
 ✔ Internal and external video players
 ✔ Parental control

Additional features are available in Pro version:
 ✔ Ad free
 ✔ Start app on device boot option, useful for set-top boxes.
 ✔ Auto-play last channel option
 ✔ Extended playlists history

This app doesn't contain any built-in channels, you should have your playlist with TV channels to use this app.

For multicast streams it's recommended to use UDP proxy:
 * for Windows: download and install UDP-to-HTTP proxy from http://borpas.info/download/UdpProxy.exe or check the corresponding option while installing IP-TV Player http://borpas.info/iptvplayer
 * for Linux: install udpxy (http://udpxy.com/index-en.html, http://sourceforge.net/projects/udpxy/)
 * the best solution would be installing udpxy on your WLAN router, this can be done for DD-WRT (http://www.dd-wrt.com) and OpenWrt (https://openwrt.org) firmware
 * some WLAN routers have built-in udpxy in manufacturer's firmware

Please join translations project at https://crowdin.com/project/iptv/invite if you want to add new or improve existing translation.

apps.title: DIIXTREAM IPTV Player
apps.summary: Smart IPTV player for Android with M3U M3U8 playlists and Xtream API
apps.description:
One playlist. Every screen.

DIIXTREAM is a smart IPTV player designed for Android TV, smartphones, and tablets.

Watch your playlists with a fast and intuitive video player optimized for both big screens and mobile devices.

DIIXTREAM supports M3U playlists, M3U8 streams, and Xtream API login so you can easily manage and play your IPTV sources.

FEATURES

PAIR YOUR TV IN SECONDS

Connect your Android TV instantly using a simple TV code.

No typing. No cables. Just sign in on your phone and your playlists appear automatically on your TV.

SYNC PLAYLISTS ACROSS DEVICES

Keep your playlists synced between your phone and Android TV.

Your playlists stay updated across devices so you can continue watching anytime.

ONE PLAYLIST, EVERY SCREEN

Use the same playlist across all your devices:

• Android TV
• Android phone
• Android tablet

Manage everything in one place.

PLAYLIST SUPPORT

DIIXTREAM works with the most common IPTV playlist formats:

• M3U playlists
• M3U8 streams
• Xtream API login

ANDROID TV OPTIMIZED

DIIXTREAM is designed specifically for Android TV.

• Smooth D-Pad navigation
• Large on-screen controls
• Comfortable big-screen viewing experience

POWERFUL VIDEO PLAYER

Enjoy smooth playback with a video player optimized for IPTV streaming.

• HD and 4K playback when supported
• Subtitle support
• Multiple audio tracks

COMPATIBILITY

DIIXTREAM works as an IPTV playlist player compatible with:

• IPTV playlists
• M3U playlist files
• M3U8 streaming links
• Xtream API login systems

IMPORTANT NOTICE

DIIXTREAM is a video player application.

DIIXTREAM does not provide, host, or distribute any content.

Users must provide their own playlists from legal sources.

Playback quality and available channels depend on the playlist provider.

Whether you want live sports, breaking news, movie channels, series, or nonstop live shows, Orbitv gives you a more flexible live TV experience on mobile and tablet.

Why users choose Orbitv
✅ Live TV discovery for sports, news, movies, series, and shows
✅ IPTV player with support for M3U playlists, M3U8 URLs, and MPD links
✅ Fast browsing by genre, country, and language
✅ Built-in player with fullscreen controls
✅ Favorites and viewing history for quicker access
✅ Casting support for compatible devices
✅ Personalized experience for users who want to organize live TV their way

Built for live entertainment
🏆 Live sports channels and sports coverage
🎬 Live movie channels and entertainment
🎭 Live series, TV shows, and event programming
📰 Live news channels and breaking headlines

More control, less friction
Orbitv is designed for users who want a practical live TV and IPTV player without unnecessary complexity. Open the app, find live channels faster, save what matters, and return in one tap.
